subject: REMEDIATION_AUTHORITY_BASIS
basis_statement: F001: Public TrainingContext construction must preserve submission-time historical immutability. It must not retain a caller-owned mutable knowledge_boundary alias; it must store an independent canonical immutable KnowledgeBoundary value, reject malformed or noncanonical boundary input, and have direct-constructor regression coverage. F002: Public TrainingAttempt construction must enforce TrainingAttempt.stage == context.knowledge_boundary.stage, reject inconsistent direct construction, and have direct-constructor regression coverage. Scope limits: no new field; no new module; no generalized validator engine; no business-scope expansion; no revision workflow expansion; no Evaluation behavior.
